song.title: Winter Breeze
song.grid: beat k at 0.5k s (+3 ms), bars every 2.0 s

edits.note: last 3 bars of the build; enters on a downbeat
cut on a bar line to the same phrase position (chroma 1.00); bass cuts at b43
cut to the riser (chroma 0.98, timbre shifts: bar-line crossfade)
beat returns on b52; 1 s ring-out

beats: First frame: constrivo. on the warm canvas
Letters squeeze into the period like an accordion (wdth 125 to 62, then scaleX), all moving toward the dot by one factor
The period grows into a black pill
"Make it real" rises out of a mask line inside the pill
Click: six iris blades close over the label; the pill becomes a circle behind them
The iris snaps open onto Taipei (day) in a circle
The circle becomes a rounded square
The square shrinks to a tile
The grid unfolds from behind it like a paper map: the plus
Reflow into a bento; Taipei takes the 2 x 2
Click the Taipei tile; the camera zooms
DROP. The zoom lands; Taipei fills the square
Glass word "light" pops in letter by letter
The letters melt into one droplet (goo)
The droplet stretches into a glass toolbar; 4 icons pop from zero
The toolbar becomes a slider; the track draws across
Press the knob: it swells into a glass lens
Drag: golden hour wipes in behind the lens; time chip counts 2:40 to 6:42 PM
Release: the lens lifts into a glass orb
The hero photo opens inside the orb as a circle
The orb expands past the frame into the lock screen; glass digits 9:41 pop
The date rises above the clock
Pull back to the whole screen; the home bar stretches into a glass music player
The lock screen pulls back into a phone; the bezel grows out of the screen edge
The Dynamic Island stretches like liquid
A droplet pinches off and flies right
It grows into a Mac window
The window rolls up like a blind: Safari underneath
Long-press the wallpaper; it lifts off the phone
Drag it onto a Safari tab; "+ New Tab" lights
Drop: the wallpaper becomes the landing page hero
Scroll: the hero morphs into a framed print on a product card; the mat grows out of the photo edge
The molding grows out of the mat
Pick a frame colour: black paints across the molding
The nav button flies down into "Order print"
Click: the button becomes one black shape, "Ordered" with a tick
"On its way": a van drives the route
"Delivered" with a tick. The bass drops out
The Delivered circle floods edge to edge in 0.3 s (overscaled past the corners) and holds black. Breakdown
The black contracts into the framed print hanging on the real wall
Click: the same iris opens onto the print; the palm shadow drifts across it
On the print: the shadow crosses mat and photo while the camera eases in
The pill shrinks back into the dot
The letters spring back out of the period, landing on the beat return
